definition: to be priced at a certain amount
description: A price comparison of three beds. First a caption reading €50 over a bare mattress lying on the carpet, where a young man flops down and curls up on it. Then €800 over an ordinary double bed with a colourful patterned duvet, where a woman sits up smiling. Finally €20,000 over a huge four-poster bed in a dark red room, where a man in a silk robe throws himself backwards onto the covers.

taps.phrase: to lie on a big bed
taps.target: the man in the red robe

en.question: How much does the big bed cost?
